api:
<Pareto data={defects} name={|d: &Defect| d.cause} value={|d: &Defect| d.count} />
PropTypeDefault
dataVec<T>, Signal<Vec<T>>, or your own Datasetrequired
nameFn(&T) -> &strrequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
thresholdf64: the dashed cumulative line, in percent80.
colorcolour of the barsthe first series colour
line_colorcolour of the cumulative linethe second series colour
show_valuesboolfalse
y_axisAxisConfig for the countsAxisConfig::new()
legend, tooltip, classas on <Trend>

Bars are sorted largest first. The cumulative share uses a second axis from 0% to 100% on the right.

examples.title: Defect causes
examples.description: Bars sorted largest first and the cumulative share; the dashed line marks 80%.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn causes() {
    let data = use_signal(defects());
    rsx! { <Pareto data={data} name={|d: &Defect| d.cause} value={|d: &Defect| d.count} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Labels and 90% line
examples.description: Counts written on the bars and a 90% threshold.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn values() {
    let data = use_signal(defects());
    rsx! { <Pareto data={data} name={|d: &Defect| d.cause} value={|d: &Defect| d.count} show_values={true} threshold={90.} color={rgb(0x8839ef)} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Support tickets
examples.code:
#[component]
fn tickets() {
    let data = use_signal(
        [
            ("Login", 412.),
            ("Billing", 198.),
            ("Export", 120.),
            ("Search", 64.),
            ("Mobile", 41.),
            ("API", 22.),
        ]
        .map(|(cause, count)| Defect { cause, count })
        .to_vec(),
    );
    rsx! { <Pareto data={data} name={|d: &Defect| d.cause} value={|d: &Defect| d.count} line_color={rgb(0xdf8e1d)} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: No legend or tooltip
examples.description: The defect chart with only bars and lines.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn bare() {

    rsx! { <Pareto data={data} name={|d: &Defect| d.cause} value={|d: &Defect| d.count} legend={Legend::hidden()} tooltip={Tooltip::hidden()} class="h-72" /> }
}
